## Checklist

- [ ] `just lint && just test` pass locally (or the commands in CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] User-visible change? Added a line under `## [Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] Nothing new talks to the network on the capture path; any new outbound request is listed in the README privacy table
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, see CONTRIBUTING.md)
